column3: Braindcast by RapidoCMS — Login Kit and Content Posting API.
The creator connects their own TikTok account. Two scopes are requested: profile info, and video publish.
The account is connected. The creator can disconnect it at any time.
They pick a video they made themselves. It is sent as is.
First we ask TikTok for the account's real settings.
The creator writes their own caption, and chooses who can see it.
Comment, Duet and Stitch stay off, as TikTok's settings require.
Your brand labels the post promotional content. Branded content, paid partnership.
Turn disclosure on without choosing, and publishing is blocked.
Every rule is checked before any call to TikTok.
The Music Usage Confirmation sits above the button.
Nothing is sent to TikTok before this tap.
TikTok accepts the post. We poll the status endpoint and show the real state.
Publication history: one status per post. Green, published. Grey, still uploading.
Red is not a bug. It's the API's reason: an unaudited client posts to private only.
The creator's TikTok profile. Every post is there, private.
Live on TikTok: same account, same caption, private for now.
Approved by the creator before anything is sent.
